description: This file defines a Java class `GLIMApplicationRejectionCommandHandler` which handles the rejection process for a GLIM loan application. It is a service component conforming to the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface and processes commands by delegating to the `LoanApplicationWritePlatformService` to reject the application.

classes.name: GLIMApplicationRejectionCommandHandler
classes.description: A service handler class that processes rejection commands for GLIM loan applications, delegating the rejection logic to the loan application's write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to reject a GLIM application, calling the `rejectGLIMApplicationApproval` method of the write platform service with the entity ID from the command.
